question.:question/worked-solution:
Here, we have the product of the two functions $u(x)=x^{2}$ and $v(x)=\cos{\left(x \right)}.$ So, we apply the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}((x^{2})(\cos{\left(x \right)}))^{'} & =u'(x)\cdot v(x)+u(x)\cdot v'(x) \\ & =(x^{2})'\cdot (\cos{\left(x \right)})+(x^{2})\cdot (\cos{\left(x \right)})' \\ & =(2 x)(\cos{\left(x \right)})+(x^{2})(- \sin{\left(x \right)}) \\ & =- x^{2} \sin{\left(x \right)} + 2 x \cos{\left(x \right)}\end{aligned}
$$

generation.domain: real x where displayed factors are differentiable
